Entry Models · Intermediate

Liquidity Sweep + MSS Model

A reversal framework that waits for a meaningful liquidity level to be swept, then requires a Market Structure Shift with displacement before considering a pullback entry.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Pre-mark PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL, equal highs/lows or session extremes.
  2. Define the sweep as a trade beyond the level followed by a close back inside, or document the chosen alternative.
  3. Wait for displacement and a selected swing break on the confirmation timeframe.
  4. Use a pre-defined FVG/OB entry, stop beyond the raided extreme and target the opposing pool.
Use when higher-timeframe draw and key liquidity location are already defined.

Common mistakes and limitations

Taking every wick as a sweep; entering on sweep alone; changing swing rules mid-review.
